moqui.math.GraphVertex.label: PROFINET flow - Fresh Air Renewal Fan VFD
Temperature/humidity control logic and setpoints (PLC CPU)

moqui.math.Parameter.textValue: Tampering of temperature/humidity sensors, VFD commands or the B-01 setpoint logic could allow the cure/smoke cycle to run outside safe time-temperature bounds. Confirmed Severe (not Major): uncontrolled curing/smoking temperature is a real HACCP critical-control-point risk (e.g. pathogen proliferation in low-acidity cured meats), and no compensating control (independent lab verification, human oversight) is documented for this real cell.

moqui.math.GraphVertex.label: Loss of PLC to remote I/O communication

moqui.math.Parameter.textValue: Loss of the PROFINET link between the PLC CPU and the remote I/O station halts process visibility/control for the batch in progress. No safety, privacy or lasting financial consequence beyond the stopped batch - Overall = Major, driven by Availability.

Bypassing or falsifying the CIP (Clean-In-Place) duct-wash interlock before the next cycle is a hygienic/HACCP critical-control-point failure, same conservative reasoning as SD-S-01 - confirmed Severe. Linked only to CVA_C_01 (the PLC CPU running the control logic): the CIP interlock logic itself has no dedicated Category-B asset yet in this Tappa 1 scope (CVA_B_01 covers temperature/humidity setpoints specifically) - a gap to fill if CIP-specific Threat Scenarios are added later, not silently folded into CVA_B_01.

Unauthorized modification of VFD speed/motor parameters (CVA_B_02) degrades airflow control quality and wastes energy, and can indirectly affect the cure/smoke environment - Financial Major drives Overall Major.

moqui.math.GraphVertex.label: Network conduit/boundary switch failure or attack

moqui.math.Parameter.textValue: Treated as a direct stop, not graceful degradation: the real factory network diagram's revision history (Rev10, most recent change) reads 'Eliminato ring switches', superseding the earlier ring-topology revisions, so MRP ring redundancy is not assumed for this corridor in the current revision. Overall = Major (same class as SD-A-01); note this switch may carry traffic for more than just this one cell (broader blast radius), which is flagged here as a note, not used to escalate severity without further evidence.

Exfiltration of temperature/humidity recipe parameters or VFD configuration via diagnostic access exposes process know-how (IP/commercial), categorized as Privacy/IP - Overall = Major, no safety or availability consequence.

moqui.math.GraphVertex.label: Spoofing of temperature/humidity/VFD status on PROFINET

moqui.math.Parameter.textValue: Access to the local PROFINET network; standard industrial fieldbuses (per IEC 62443-3-3 Annex A) commonly carry no native message authentication, so a node presenting plausible sensor/VFD status frames can be accepted as genuine.

moqui.math.GraphVertex.label: Tampering of VFD setpoints via PROFINET

moqui.math.Parameter.textValue: Network access to the PROFINET segment, or compromise of an already-present node, sufficient to write cyclic/acyclic process values directly to the VFD.
Physical or network access to the local segment (diagnostic port, switch port) sufficient to saturate traffic or inject malformed frames toward the CPU's communication processor.

moqui.math.GraphVertex.label: Tampering of CIP interlock logic in PLC program

moqui.math.Parameter.textValue: Weakly-authenticated engineering/online access to the PLC (e.g. default or shared programming credentials) sufficient to modify the interlock condition directly in the running program or memory.
Physical access to the VFD's local keypad, or network access via PROFINET acyclic (parameter) services, without independent verification of the change.

moqui.math.GraphVertex.label: Denial of Service against the zone boundary switch

moqui.math.Parameter.textValue: Network access to the corridor segment sufficient to cause a broadcast storm or MAC flooding against the boundary switch. Relevant real norm anchor: IEC 62443-3-3 SR 7.1 (Denial of service protection).

moqui.math.GraphVertex.label: Elevation of privilege on switch management interface

moqui.math.Parameter.textValue: Network-reachable switch management interface with default/weak credentials, allowing VLAN reconfiguration or port shutdown. Relevant real norm anchor: IEC 62443-3-3 SR 5.2 (Zone boundary protection).
Network access to the PLC's diagnostic/engineering port without independent authentication, sufficient to read process/recipe parameters.
